title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly! Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use. Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems. This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data. What you will do Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption. Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration. Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code. Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products. Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution. Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery. Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing. title: Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d)
description: Your Role & How we work As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics. You work closely with Quantitative Research, AI Engineering, Product & Data, and the investment team, and we treat agentic AI as a default in how we build. What you will do Build and improve the internal products the investment and research teams use daily: data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and tooling, on top of our lakehouse and orchestration stack. Work directly with the teams you build for: take in their requests, triage and prioritise them, protect the integrity and consistency of the product, and explain features and implementation trade-offs in clear, non-technical language. Design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines, ETLs and integrations that handle complex financial and alternative datasets. Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation. Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling. Use agentic AI across engineering work (coding, review, testing, debugging, documentation) and help the team push these practices forward. The experience you bring 3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production. Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling. Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them. Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain what you built, why, and what it will and will not do, and you can say no constructively. Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work. Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics. Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production. 2 reasons why you should not apply You prefer fully specified tickets and no contact with users. You are curious about how investment decisions are made and want to understand the data behind them, not just move it. You see AI-powered development as a competitive advantage, not a novelty, and use agentic AI as a core part of how you work. You communicate clearly on progress, trade-offs, and risk, and you own problems end-to-end. SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company with a diversified portfolio of lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. About the role

We are looking for a technically strong, proactive and detail-oriented Senior Product Integrity Engineer to join our UK team, with a focus on design assurance, engineering validation and product quality.

Embedded within the New Product Development (NPD) process, you will take ownership of product integrity activities from concept through to production launch, ensuring quality, safety, reliability and consumer expectations are built into the design.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to lead risk assessment and validation activities. You will use engineering judgement, test evidence and consumer insights to challenge designs, resolve risks and influence decisions at critical development milestones.

This role offers broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to directly influence whether our products deliver SharkNinja’s 5-star quality standard.

Key responsibilities

Design assurance and engineering validation

  • Lead product integrity input into design reviews, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), design verification and validation planning (DVP&R), and safety reviews throughout the NPD lifecycle.

  • Own the development and delivery of risk-based verification and validation plans, establishing clear test methods, acceptance criteria and evidence requirements aligned with product specifications and applicable UK, European and other target-market requirements.

  • Challenge design assumptions and assess product performance, reliability, robustness and foreseeable use conditions, ensuring risks are understood and addressed before tooling and production release.

  • Evaluate engineering changes for their impact on quality, safety and performance, defining appropriate revalidation requirements to prevent regression.

  • Review and approve quality-related manufacturing and test documentation within your remit, ensuring requirements are clearly translated into production controls.

  • Contribute to Design for Manufacture (DFM) reviews, assessing tolerances, process capability and potential sources of manufacturing variation.

  • Provide evidence-based recommendations on product readiness, escalating unresolved risks and driving corrective action ahead of development milestones.

Cross-functional leadership and quality governance

  • Represent product integrity within cross-functional NPD teams, translating consumer expectations and quality requirements into practical engineering decisions.

  • Lead quality risk and action reviews, establishing clear ownership, priorities and closure criteria.

  • Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers to define process controls, quality gates and production acceptance criteria ahead of mass production.

  • Lead technical investigation of issues identified during prototype, pilot and pre-production builds, coordinating root-cause analysis and verifying corrective action effectiveness.

  • Challenge supplier 8D investigations and corrective action proposals, ensuring conclusions are supported by robust evidence.

  • Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities addressing design and process gaps, tracking actions through to verified closure.

  • Provide technical guidance to colleagues and support the development of consistent product integrity practices across programmes.

Data analysis and continuous improvement

  • Analyse validation results, build data, test failures and relevant field performance insights to identify emerging risks and prioritise improvements.

  • Define and monitor quality metrics, validation coverage and acceptance criteria throughout the development cycle.

  • Apply lessons from existing products to new designs, strengthening test coverage and preventing repeat failures.

  • Improve validation methods and pre-production quality processes, addressing systemic gaps with sustainable solutions.

  • Communicate validation status, residual risks and corrective action progress clearly to senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.

Skills and experience

Essential

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Quality Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Substantial relevant engineering experience, typically gained over five or more years, with demonstrated ownership of design verification, validation or product integrity activities.

  • Practical experience leading DFMEA, DVP&R, technical design reviews and engineering change assessments.

  • A strong understanding of product development lifecycles, design and document control, and verification and validation methodologies.

  • Experience translating product requirements and engineering risks into measurable test plans and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong technical problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to interpret test data and assess corrective action effectiveness.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, challenge technical decisions constructively and drive issues through to resolution.

  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to engineering teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Confidence managing multiple programmes and competing priorities in a fast-paced development environment.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience using data to support engineering decisions.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams, regions and supplier partners.

Desirable

  • Experience developing consumer appliances, electromechanical products or other high-volume consumer goods.

  • Experience working within rapid NPD cycles and supporting products through tooling, pilot builds and production launch.

  • Knowledge of reliability engineering, accelerated life testing, statistical analysis or Design of Experiments (DOE).

  • Familiarity with supplier quality processes, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), process capability assessment and incoming quality controls.

  • Understanding of applicable product safety standards and UK and European product compliance requirements.

  • Experience incorporating human factors, usability and foreseeable misuse into product validation.

  • Experience working with international manufacturing partners and suppliers.

Travel

The role may require travel within the UK and internationally to support development builds, manufacturing sites and supplier activities.

description:

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

We are seeking an SDET to join one of our agile engineering teams and help us build quality into LUMA, our scientific software platform. You'll take ownership of testing for a specific module of the application — writing and maintaining automated tests, exploring new features, and working alongside developers, application scientists and DevOps engineers to make sure what we ship is reliable.

This is a hands-on automation role with room to grow. You'll be contributing to established test frameworks rather than building them from scratch, with support from senior SDETs who will help you develop your technical depth and your understanding of the science behind the product.

While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.

 In this role you will get to:

  • Write, maintain and extend automated test suites for your module using Cucumber, TypeScript and Cypress (and Playwright where we use it).
  •  Own day-to-day quality for your area: contributing test scenarios during planning, testing stories as they're built, and giving the team a clear picture of release readiness.
  • Design and document test cases that cover functional, regression and integration scenarios, and keep them useful as the product evolves.
  • Investigate and reproduce defects, raise well-evidenced bug reports in JIRA, and verify fixes with developers and scientists.
  • Keep your tests green and trustworthy in our CI pipelines, and help improve how tests run and report.
  • Learn to read and interpret API documentation and turn it into meaningful automated coverage.
  • Work with leading experts in software development, scientific product management and test automation — and be mentored by them.

Who we're looking for:

You'll have 2–5 years' experience in QA/testing, including at least a year of hands-on test automation. You're comfortable working in a code-first way, you enjoy digging into how things work, and you're happy asking questions when a domain is unfamiliar. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria.

Just as importantly, you want to get better. We're looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time.

The Key Skills we are looking for:

  • Practical experience with Cypress — writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. Experience testing React applications is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript, including asynchronous code (promises, async/await). You don't need to be an expert in generics and interfaces, but you should be able to read and write clean, maintainable test code.
  • Experience with BDD / Cucumber, or a willingness to pick it up quickly — we write most of our specs in Gherkin.
  • Test case design and documentation — the ability to break a feature down into clear, repeatable scenarios and write them up so others can follow them.
  • Comfort with Git and GitHub, including branching, pull requests and code review, plus experience working in JIRA or a similar tracking system.

You may also have:

  • Experience with Playwright, or interest in learning it — we use it for a subset of our tests.
  • Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST clients) or writing API-level automated tests.
  •  Any experience with performance or load testing (K6 or similar).
  •  Familiarity with validating data integrity across release upgrades, migrations or schema changes.
  •  A background or interest in science, engineering or research software.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

 Why be a Senior Ecommerce Executive at THG Beauty? 

Operates at a more senior level than Ecommerce Executive, owning relationships and providing direction. Thorough skills across data analysis, SQL and manipulating data. Understands the 'why' behind actions, not just the fact we are actioning them.

*Dutch or French Speaking role*

As Senior Ecommerce Executive you’ll:  

  • Systems: lead training and learning on TeePee, Superset, Tableau, ContentSquare, Campaign Manager and GA; manipulate SQL independently.
  • Offers: independently set up all offer types; act as a point of contact for other team members requiring support.
  • KPIs: proactively suggest and take actions to influence Revenue, GP, AOV, CVR & Traffic.
  • Site Execution: set an example in the use of systems to understand and enhance the customer journey from a trade perspective; competently use CSQ (Zoning, Journey, Workspace analysis).
  • GP: own the 'why' behind trade actions; drive GP-focused decisions with greater autonomy.
  • Cross channel/function collaboration: drive trading actions with greater autonomy. Ownership of multiple categories/channels.
  • Change Management: understand business needs and priorities; help lead the redistribution of workload across the team to hit deadlines.
  • Ownerships: thorough understanding of individual and team roles; drive own areas and support others with theirs.
  • Knowledge Sharing: set an example in how knowledge and insight is shared across and outside the team 

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

  • Prioritisation: independently prioritise workload; support team members to do the same.
  • Organisation: independently manage own workload; support others to organise theirs.
  • Collaboration: lead collaboration across and outside the team; drive process improvements.
  • Communication: strong written/verbal communication, flexed for the audience and division.
  • Active Listening: lead by example in meetings.
  • Growth Mindset: proactively identify and close gaps in own knowledge.
  • Accountability: strong attention to detail in own work.
  • Role Model: demonstrate leadership across the Executive level within the team.

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
     
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 

  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service. 

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.
